parsed.headline: Denied: No in-person visit within 6 months prior to ordering CGM.
parsed.explanation: This claim is denied because the record does not show that, within six (6) months prior to ordering the CGM, the treating practitioner had an in-person visit with the beneficiary to evaluate their diabetes control. The governing policy states: "Within six (6) months prior to ordering the CGM, the treating practitioner has an in-person visit with the beneficiary to evaluate their diabetes control and determined that criteria (1-4) above are met; and,".
parsed.what_to_do: Submit documentation of an in-person visit within 6 months prior to ordering the CGM if available.
